summary: chore(settings, content-server): remove leftover Pocket code
description:
Because:

* Pocket is discontinued, and its Terms of Service strings are gone.
* Dead Pocket product code stayed in content-server, settings and dev-launcher.

This commit:

* Deletes the unused Pocket migration mixin, experiment, link and logo map
* Removes the Pocket style and unreferenced Pocket SVG files
* Removes the Pocket case from Connected Services, so it uses the default icon
* Removes the browser.pocket.enabled pref from fxa-dev-launcher

Closes FXA-14802
